summary: RETEST passed end-to-end. SQLite Error 21 fix (split CREATE TABLEs + initPromise) resolved the red overlay; dashboard now loads cleanly. Created card, MSI, income and quick-expense via category chip; alert switch toggles; dashboard reflects combined limit ($50,000), MSI debt ($24,000) and expenses ($250) correctly; persistence verified via reload. Found and fixed an unrelated CRITICAL: alertas.tsx used <TouchableOpacity> without importing it, which threw 'TouchableOpacity is not defined' red-screen the moment the Alertas tab was opened.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. <TouchableOpacity> was used (request-permissions button) but missing from the react-native import. Caused red overlay 'TouchableOpacity is not defined' on entering Alertas tab. Added TouchableOpacity to the import.

integration_issues.issue: tabBarTestID prop on Tabs.Screen does NOT propagate to web DOM (Expo Router renders tabs as <a href="/...">). Selectors like [data-testid="tab-tarjetas"] do not exist on web. Recommend wrapping tabBarButton with a custom component that accepts testID, or document href-based selectors for web tests. Functionality works fine via href, no user-visible bug.

issues: Console warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking, comes from ModalSheet/FormControls. Should migrate to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Optional) Replace tabBarTestID with a custom tabBarButton that forwards testID to the underlying anchor so the requested tab-* testIDs work on web. Functionality is unaffected.
Clean up 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warnings in ModalSheet/FormControls.
Verified by testing agent: no further action needed for the SQLite issue or the alertas TouchableOpacity import.
critical_code_review_comments: src/db/database.ts: per-statement execAsync + initPromise pattern is correct and resolves the sqlite-wasm Error 21.
(tabs)/alertas.tsx: missing TouchableOpacity import (now fixed) — recommend enabling stricter TS/ESLint rules to catch undefined identifiers in JSX (e.g., 'react/jsx-no-undef').

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 flows verified: no overlay, tab nav, create card/MSI/income/quick-expense, alert switch toggle, dashboard values correct, persistence after reload)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 card (BBVA Oro, $50k MXN limit), 1 MSI (iPhone 15, $24k/12m), 1 income (Nomina $30k), 1 expense ($250 Comida). All persisted across reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://f7b8ac23-d443-4669-a391-812951fc4cd4.preview.emergentagent.com . Wait ~10s after navigation for sqlite-wasm + bundle. Tab testIDs (tab-tarjetas etc.) are NOT in the web DOM — use a[href='/tarjetas'], a[href='/msi'], a[href='/movimientos'], a[href='/alertas'], a[href='/']. All other testIDs work as expected with [data-testid="..."]. Forms are unstyled inputs (page.fill works directly). Playwright contexts are isolated, so to test SQLite persistence you must reload within the SAME browser session (page.reload + wait 8-10s).
rca_of_issue: Two issues confirmed in this iteration: (1) Original RCA — sqlite-wasm SQLITE_MISUSE caused by multi-statement execAsync — resolved by E1 by splitting schema into individual CREATE TABLEs and adding initPromise to serialize concurrent getDb() calls. Verified: no Error 21 on initial load or after reload. (2) New issue — alertas.tsx referenced TouchableOpacity without importing it (Activar permission button). Reproduction: navigate to /alertas tab → Expo red overlay 'TouchableOpacity is not defined' at app/(tabs)/alertas.tsx:75:12. Mitigation applied by testing agent: added TouchableOpacity to the existing 'react-native' import line. Verified: alertas screen now renders, switch (alert-switch-paid-{id}) toggles correctly, no overlay.
